content.intro: In this lesson, you will learn **Assignment and Compound Assignment** as part of **Data Types, Operators, and Expressions**. Apply assignment and compound assignment by identifying the required behavior, the relevant Kotlin type/API, and the conditions under which the expected result can fail. Use the subtopics—The Assignment Operator, Compound Assignment Operators, Assignment-Related Type Constraints—as a checklist: predict what the example will do, then verify it in a project configured for the target platform.
content.why_it_matters: Clear fundamentals help you reason about program behavior before adding abstraction. Small input/output checks make syntax and control flow easier to debug.
